$comment: Registry of every component forge installs. installed[] lists ways to detect it locally (first hit wins); latest says where the newest public version lives (never a pinned version); install/update are exact commands per platform (afterUpdate lists notes shown with an update command, as a list or per platform; a detector in installed[] may carry its own update, and requires, for a component found that way: pip, uv tool, pipx, a loose skill; a plain list holds on every platform; requires lists tools the commands need, as a list or per platform), printed by scripts/doctor.mjs and never run without the user's yes. Paths: ~ is the home dir, %VAR% an environment variable. Slots in a command: {claudeDir} is the Claude config folder (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude), always the value of an assignment; whenEnv.<VAR> holds the install/update commands used instead of the default ones when the environment variable VAR is set, with {VAR} as its value; a plugin detector with name (not id) finds the plugin under any marketplace, and {id} in its update is the plugin id of each instance. Every slot value enters the printed command inside single quotes.
